# `kll_sketch_agg_float`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
kll_sketch_agg_float(expr[, k])
```

Returns the KllFloatsSketch compact binary representation.
The optional k parameter controls the size and accuracy of the sketch (default 200, range 8-65535).
Larger k values provide more accurate quantile estimates but result in larger, slower sketches.

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Not implemented yet |
| Group | `agg_funcs` |
| Kind | aggregate (function) |
| Added in Spark | 4.1.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 4.1 and later |
| Arguments | [1, 2] |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- kll_sketch_agg_float, example 1
> SELECT LENGTH(kll_sketch_to_string_float(kll_sketch_agg_float(col))) > 0 FROM VALUES (CAST(1.0 AS FLOAT)), (CAST(2.0 AS FLOAT)), (CAST(3.0 AS FLOAT)), (CAST(4.0 AS FLOAT)), (CAST(5.0 AS FLOAT)) tab(col);
Error: KRISHIV_UNSUPPORTED_FEATURE
```

```sql
-- kll_sketch_agg_float, example 2
> SELECT LENGTH(kll_sketch_to_string_float(kll_sketch_agg_float(col, 400))) > 0 FROM VALUES (CAST(1.0 AS FLOAT)), (CAST(2.0 AS FLOAT)), (CAST(3.0 AS FLOAT)), (CAST(4.0 AS FLOAT)), (CAST(5.0 AS FLOAT)) tab(col);
Error: KRISHIV_UNSUPPORTED_FEATURE
```
